scripts.typecheck: find examples packages -name '*.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && tsc --noEmit || echo '(no TypeScript files yet — skipping typecheck)'
scripts.lint: find examples packages -name '*.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && oxlint || echo '(no files to lint yet)'
scripts.lint:fix: find examples packages -name '*.ts' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && oxlint --fix || echo '(no files to lint yet)'
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run fmt:check && bun run lint
